reviewed_boundaries: real PostgreSQL postmaster restart preserves shared content references, terminal deletion and exact replay
quarantine storage effects survive failures and reconcile without false terminal state
publication requires complete ownership, source, version, validity, classification and ACL metadata
source nodes preserve Original, Page, Section, Table and Chunk provenance
C06 authorization and C07 Tenant scope fail closed before catalog access
withdrawal, expiry and deletion are excluded from current retrieval and propagate to source nodes
accepted_p2_limitations: the dynamic C06 coverage test does not enumerate every public operation even though code inspection found no missing authorization path
the database does not independently force every pending storage effect to match the terminal document state and receipt; the application enforces this pairing

verified_assertions: Only the seven frozen F02-derived Synthetic fixtures can enter the C10 quarantine; unknown or Enterprise references fail closed.
Content bytes are hash-bound, scoped by Tenant reference, deduplicated without merging document identity, and erased only after the last reference is deleted.
Inspection rejects size, type, macro, synthetic virus marker and hidden-instruction risks before parsing.
The replaceable parser seam returns candidate-only recursively closed nodes; the frozen PBM transcript is not claimed as production OCR.
Publication requires Owner, source, version, validity, classification and ACL, while parser output remains non-authoritative candidate content.
Every exposed catalog operation reauthorizes through C06 and enters a C07-signed Synthetic Tenant transaction before storage access.
Version, as-of, withdrawal, expiration and deletion rules exclude unusable content and preserve append-only evidence.
PUT and ERASE effects, idempotency receipts and reconciliation survive service reconstruction and a real PostgreSQL restart without duplicate side effects.
PostgreSQL runtime roles are non-owner NOBYPASSRLS roles and all Tenant-scoped tables use ENABLE and FORCE RLS.
limitations: Verification covers only frozen Synthetic documents and three Synthetic Tenants; no enterprise document, endpoint, credential, identity or Connector is present.
The quarantine adapter is not a production object store, and synthetic risk markers are not antivirus, DLP or malware-engine validation.
The deterministic parser and preset PBM transcript do not verify Docling, Tika, OCR, PDF, Office, encrypted-file or scanned-document production quality.
C06 operation coverage is enforced in code, but the dynamic test does not enumerate every public operation.
Pending storage effect pairing is enforced by the application; the database does not independently prove every effect-to-terminal-state and receipt match.
PostgreSQL tests use one-use local instances over Unix sockets; production network policy, mTLS, managed-service behavior, backup, disaster recovery, capacity, HA and soak are not verified.
C11 remains responsible for permission-aware retrieval and model-context exclusion; C10 verification alone does not prove RAG behavior.
This evidence does not approve G1, enter P2 or permit P3 enterprise integration.
